author: Kushal
problem: Read a 9 x 9 grid where '#' is a pawn and '.' is empty. Print how many squares, including tilted ones, have a pawn on all four of their corners.
bug_description: In the 45-degree diamond check the right corner's row is i+1 instead of i+k+1, so diamonds larger than the smallest are tested at the wrong cell.

comments.accurate: Counts squares of every size and tilt whose four corners all hold pawns
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts squares with pawns on all four corners, checking each diamond's right corner one row below its top corner
comments.wrong_location: Diamond corner offsets verified; check the hard-coded corners of the largest tilted squares
